notes.title: Backroads content update out now
notes.content:
[b]The content update for Decimate Drive, the indie horror game in which killer cars are out for blood, is out now! It's a free update featuring a new story mode, new killer cars and much more.[/b]

[previewyoutube=XhLo6r8gZRU;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Backroads[/h3]

The new (short) story mode is set in a remote backcountry where killer cars rely on heavy for to remain unseen. It features six new locations and six new killer cars.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194917/253d946f5068127a5db6062f04c96804a60ef774.png[/img]
[h3]Killer car gallery[/h3]

This content update also adds a gallery so you can view all killer cars and some important objects from the story. Finding collectibles will unlock more of the gallery.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194917/75db85d3868db2e1fb89c2fb8e8142794ac2215a.png[/img]
[h3]Much more[/h3]

- New dash ability to dodge enemies at the last second.
- New crouch ability to take routes where enemies can't follow you.
- Additional cinematics for the main story line.
- Improvements to the Hit & Run arcade mode.
- Tweaks to make unfair kills less likely.
- Other small improvements and bug fixes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194917/63c52dff418e42f66c4a106d84a5ca5602f2a16d.png[/img]
The content update is now available, so check it out!

notes.title: Preview: Decimate Drive Backroads
notes.content:
[b]The content update for Decimate Drive, the indie horror game about getting hunted by killer cars, will be out soon! The content update is titled Backroads and will feature a new story mode, new killer cars and much more.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194917/c709878649c360b21b76cae8580d8c9ad7bcb44e.png[/img]
[h3]Backroads[/h3]

In the last devlog I talked shortly about the setting of Backroads, a remote backcountry where killer cars rely on heavy fog to remain unseen. I can now confirm that the new (short) story mode will feature six new locations. From forests with dense vegetation to crop fields littered with barns.

The content will also feature six new killer cars... or vehicles to be exact 😁

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194917/56cd23143a3dd8302c1b4d9e34cfa3bfb7af8086.png[/img]
[h3]New moves[/h3]

The content update will also feature some new moves for the player. The biggest addition being the dash ability, allowing you to dodge cars at the last second. Crouching is now also possible, so you can take routes where enemies can't follow you.

Both new moves will be available in all game modes, including the main story and arcade mode.

[h3]Soon-ish[/h3]

Backroads will be out this month, so keep an eye out for the release announcement!

notes.title: Devlog: Coming soon-ish
notes.content:
Alright, time for an update on how the release of Decimate Drive went and the future of the game. And... also a quick reminder that the 15% discount will be ending soon! 😁

[h3]The release[/h3]
All in all the release went pretty smoothly! Of course there are always a couple of bugs that need fixing, but luckily none of them were game breaking. Special thanks to everyone who reported bugs and issues in the playtest and demo!

I did do a small update (version 1.0.1) earlier this week and a bigger update (version 1.0.2) is available now. If you find a bug or issue that I might have missed, don't forget that you can report them in the game or [url=https://forms.gle/jLinucGuFzxuhfeJ9]here[/url].

[h3]About the story[/h3]
Based on feedback it's clear the story needed improving. The latest update of Decimate Drive (version 1.0.2) includes changes to make the story simpler and clearer.

Don't worry if this story line is still not your thing. What I have in mind right now is to release content updates with different story lines or game modes. This gives me the freedom to do whatever seems the most fun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194917/3e1f077544a25bcbffca4b9623e7867962e939b2.png[/img]

[h3]Coming soon-ish[/h3]
You can expect these content updates soon-ish.  As usual I don't have a clearly defined plan for the game. So don't expect me to give release dates for the content updates or an announcement for a sequel 😅

Thanks everyone for checking out the full release! It's awesome to see you all play the game and react to it.

notes.title: Decimate Drive is out now
notes.content:
Decimate Drive is out now on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2427950/Decimate_Drive/]Steam[/url]. Time to find out if you have what it takes to outsmart a pack of killer cars.

[previewyoutube=6nTaKsijXDI;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]It's run or die in a killer car infested city. Dash from dumpster to park bench and don’t make a wrong move. Ice cream trucks, snowplows and dodgy vans all want you dead. Decimate Drive, a short indie game, is terrifyingly fast-paced and drenched in atmospheric horror.[/b]

Get the game now on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2427950/Decimate_Drive/]Steam[/url].

I hope you enjoy the game! Don't forget to let me know what you think! Leave a review, post bugs / give feedback or join the Discord community. Thanks again to everyone who playtested the game and tried out the demo. It helped me a lot with figuring out what to add to the game, what to fix etc.

[h3]Frequently asked questions[/h3]

[b]What are the plans for the game after its release?[/b]

The plan is to add new content to the game in the future. Because I don't work on the game full-time it's hard to say what content will be coming when.

[b]Can my system run the game?[/b]

If you want to be sure your system can run the game, I recommend trying out the demo. Even if you tried the demo before. It has been updated with new settings for low-end machines.

[b]I'm experiencing problems when playing the game, where can I get support?[/b]

If you are experiencing problems when playing Decimate Drive you can ask for support in the #support channel on Discord.

notes.title: Devlog: Out of the shadows
notes.content:
This weeks devlog of Decimate Drive, a game set in a killer car infested city, is about the upcoming release and some late additions.

[h3]Release?[/h3]

At the moment I'm busy with the last couple of bugs, some late additions and offline playtests. This is going pretty well so... if everything goes according to plan... the game will be released in February or March.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194917/baaf2e80c3cb5efe9f3d43eafbc4337fb65757f7.png[/img]

[h3]Late additions[/h3]
One of the late additions are battery pickups. They increase the range of the flashlight for a little while. They're totally optional so you won't be searching for batteries all the time with multiple cars chasing you... because I somehow think that would be more frustrating than fun 😄

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194917/92059d5b5aa956afbd7cf3c1fdf97b6181049e59.png[/img]

There are a bunch of additions like the batteries which weren't in the playtest or demo. So it'll be really interesting to see how they'll play out!

If you're tracking the development of the game I can imagine the last month or so were a bit boring. Thank you for your patience and I hope we can make the coming months way more interesting 😬

[h3]New demo available[/h3]
Get an idea of what Decimate Drive is all about by trying out the new demo. It contains gameplay and a bit of story. The biggest additions since the last playtest update (more on that below) are the new game plus mode and collectibles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194917/68b6d5c4e5dc443889ada1f699dccc3872f53fb9.png[/img]

[list]

[*] Improved lighting and a gamma slider
[*] Smoother movement and a look-back-feature

[h3]On to Early Access[/h3]
The release of the demo is a small detour along the road to an Early Access release. Since Decimate Drive is a game I work on in my spare time, it’s difficult to give an exact release date. I’m aiming for the beginning of 2024 at the moment. Time will tell!

notes.title: Devlog: New wheels
notes.content:
This weeks devlog of Decimate Drive is about the levels and cars I've been working on (which you can check out in the latest playtest update). [b]Want to try out Decimate Drive? Join [url=https://discord.com/channels/1113374677839126528]Discord[/url] to find out how to start playtesting. Go to the #playtest channel after joining Discord for more info.[/b] [h3]Levels up[/h3] At the moment I'm spending most time on new levels and extending existing levels. Each level comes with it's own unique location and gameplay style. One of the latest additions is a level based on a typical American suburb. With its open streets it offers backyards and alleys which are ideal for taking cover. But cars can also come at you from more direction. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194917/cb74276a8adad4f69b1962b469211d913ae069ff.png[/img] Levels which have been included in the playtest have also been extended. Letting you spend more 'quality time' in each location. [h3]Out of the fight[/h3] To add a tactical twist to the game it's now possible to trap cars. Pay attention to your surroundings and you'll be able to spot ideal locations to trap a car. This puts them out of the fight, giving you a better chance to make it through the level. Only for a little while though... [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194917/60b3dcc0a37e0f144a791ee692193f5e89153d51.png[/img]

Heavy traffic

As we get closer to the early access release, you'll be seeing new cars appear in Decimate Drive. My goal is to add a nice variety of vehicle types, each with their own strengths and weaknesses. But cars can also come at you from more direction.
Levels which have been included in the playtest have also been extended. Letting you spend more 'quality time' in each location.

To add a tactical twist to the game it's now possible to trap cars. Pay attention to your surroundings and you'll be able to spot ideal locations to trap a car. This puts them out of the fight, giving you a better chance to make it through the level. Only for a little while though...
As we get closer to the early access release, you'll be seeing new cars appear in Decimate Drive. My goal is to add a nice variety of vehicle types, each with their own strengths and weaknesses.

notes.title: Devlog: Hands on
notes.content:
This weeks devlog of Decimate Drive is about the upcoming playtest and some of the new stuff that will be included.

[h3]Upcoming playtest[/h3]

Want to help improve the game and try out some of the new content? Join [url=https://discord.gg/jqwHrgZYny]Discord[/url] or check out the next devlog so you don't miss out. You'll be able to join the playtest soon. As always, there are just a couple of last fixes that need to be done. 😅

[h3]Dangerous cargo[/h3]

Every vehicle in Decimate Drive will be dangerous in its own way. Everything from speed, size to a 2 by 4 sticking out of one of the windows.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194917/ceb97c351b10301567ee4b88a791397e1268b4e0.png[/img]

[h3]Pedestrian[/h3]

An improvement I made recently was adding hands to the player. This adds a bit of polish to the game and has the added bonus of telling people new to Decimate Drive that you're definitely now the one driving.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194917/515125b6361351589c88288172c1bd0dac2d1aa8.png[/img]

[h3]Staying up to date[/h3]

You can now see what I’m working on, what feedback I’ve gathered and what bugs were reported (once playtesting has started 😁) on the [url=https://trello.com/b/b5RKu593/decimate-drive-roadmap]public roadmap[/url].
